prompt: You control a real simulated XYZ yaw gantry with a parallel gripper. No tools. Use the image(s) and telemetry, not internal state. Image resolution 480x360. Pixel (0,0) is top left. Millimetres; world +X is right, +Y away from camera. Positive yaw is counterclockwise from above. Fixed brass pins are on a dark base. Movable gray plate has two holes. Jaws grasp across its short sides. Output exactly one JSON object. initial alignment plus requested overhead view. Current wrist world [x,y,z,yaw] [43.0, 7.5, 34.9, -6.6]. Decide whether to keep original pose for insertion or replace it with a relative correction. Return {"op":"insert"} if ready to lower along Z; or {"op":"correct","dx":mm,"dy":mm,"dyaw":degrees} to adjust based on the visible holes and pins before insertion.
